facts.fact: Lusaka Times reports ZICTA director general Collins Mbulo saying on 16 February 2026 that the Cyber Security Act of 2025 will be strictly enforced against people who misuse social media and AI to create fake images and videos of the President and others.

ZICTA's director general said that, working with other law enforcement agencies, it had apprehended some internet abusers, many now appearing before the courts, in the context of AI-generated fake images and videos of the President; no case is named.

ZMB.note: No government use of AI stated.

facts.fact: ZICTA director general Collins Mbulo called the Cyber Security Act of 2025 the new law that will now be strictly enforced.

ZICTA's director general said some internet abusers had been apprehended and many were appearing before the courts, in a push against fake AI images and videos of President Hichilema; no individual is named.
